name: Tsuki no Nai Michi
source:
Consequent disappearances start to happen in a neighboring town. Four people witness a suspicious person on the way home from school. Main character decides to investigate this incident.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/07/vn-of-month-january-2004-paradise-lost.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
邻镇开始接连发生失踪事件。四个人在放学回家的路上目击了一名可疑人物，主人公决定调查这件事。

（摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/07/vn-of-month-january-2004-paradise-lost.html]vndbreview[/url]）
